messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty trigger PD-4708 - inference-queue-depth-critical for service/inference-hosted-main. queue_depth=67, p95_latency=3.6s, 5xx_rate=18% :rotating_light: severity=P1

Alex Chen: acked PD, taking lead. PD link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-4708

Samir Patel: oncall here. first checks: node provisioning & autoscaler controller health. who can grab controller logs and ASG status?

Marta Ruiz: grabbing infra console + k8s. `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/queue-autoscaler --tail=200` shows `ErrResourceQuota: not enough vcpu quota` and repeated `reconcile loop aborted` errors.

Nora Li: AWS shows vCPU quota exhausted in region eu-west-1. ASG maxed out at desired=180, max=180, but instances failing to launch. Support case opened but quota increase will take hours.

Samir Patel: mitigation options: 1) spin up alternate nodegroup in different region/az with different instance family 2) fall back lower-priority traffic to cached responses 3) route traffic to Dedicated capacity for enterprise customers.

Alex Chen: prioritize quick customer impact reduction. Start plan: create cross-family nodegroup in same region with smaller instance types that aren't hitting quota, enable temporary spot fallback. Also patch autoscaler to ignore quota error and continue reconciling when nodes eventually register.

Marta Ruiz: initiating terraform to create nodegroup ng-burst-altfam (mixed instance types) and enabling spot fallback. `terraform apply` started.

deploy-bot: terraform run tf-9003 started for module=infra/nodegroups/ng-burst-altfam

Samir Patel: while nodes come up, let's throttle PLG traffic and route known heavy prefixes to degraded-model-1 to reduce worker CPU. Alex, can you update rate-limit rule?

Alex Chen: updating edge rate-limit rule to 60% for anonymous/plg tier and enabling route-weight to degraded-model-1 for `/v1/generate` for noisy API keys. Pushing change now.

Nora Li: Cloud shows instances registering to ASG, but k8s node join delayed due to bootstrap script failing on a specific AMI. Starting a parallel nodegroup with a different AMI I know works.

Marta Ruiz: spun ng-burst-altfam with alt AMI, nodes joining. kube node count increased from 180 -> 210.

Samir Patel: autoscaler controller now logs successful reconcile and desired replicas scaling up from 80 -> 160. queue depth trending: 67 -> 42 -> 20 in 6 minutes.

Alex Chen: customer-facing symptoms: timeouts and high latency on streaming endpoints have decreased; 5xx down from 18% -> 4.5%. Observability shows slow consumer catch-up.

Nora Li: temporary measures: (1) PLG throttling (2) degraded-model route (3) spot fallback enabled. Creating internal ops ticket OPS-1245 to record exact commands.

Marta Ruiz: note for post-incident: autoscaler treats quota failures as terminal. Add a retry-with-backoff and a quota-alert. Also add an automated fallback enabling alternate nodegroup when quota errors seen.

Samir Patel: handoff — I'll stay on for 30m to confirm stability then loop in eng-sre + infra for postmortem. Alex, Nora, Marta: please file follow-up action items: quota request, autoscaler code change, automated fallback.

incident-bot: PD-4708 acknowledged by Alex Chen. Suggested tags: autoscaler, quota, mitigation.

Alex Chen: marking mitigated in PD after 22m from first page. queue drained to 6 and p95 latency at 0.9s. 5xx at 0.9%.

Nora Li: will file cloud support case CS-10012 for vCPU quota and schedule quota increase. Also scheduling a retro with infra & autoscaler owner tomorrow.

Marta Ruiz: documenting commands used and terraform run id tf-9003 in OPS-1245. will draft runbook updates to auto-enable ng-burst-altfam on quota errors.

Samir Patel: closing handoff, leaving thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks team.

Alex Chen: thanks all. please include exact timings, Terraform run id, and rate-limit changes in the PM.
